title: Dummy Tappasu
desc: An obese man, living in the slums of Chennai, comes across a series of situations that change his perception towards life and love.

title: Edhyathai Thirudathey
desc: Prakash, who is diagnosed with terminal cancer, and Geethanjali, an equally ill patient, fall in love with each other. However, when she learns about his illness, she decides to move out of his life.

title: Iniyavaley
desc: Prabhakar is firm on marrying only after he clears his exams and becomes a collector. When his parents fix his marriage, his protests lead to complications and he ends up marrying the bride's sister.

title: Iravum Pagalum Varu
desc: Karthi, a college student, indulges in petty thieving. But his life changes when a corrupt police officer decides to use him for performing illegal activities.

title: Minnale
desc: A man falls in love with a woman and cons his way into her heart through lies. When she finds out and confronts him, he has no sign of remorse as he feels that everything is fair in love and war.

title: Agilan
desc: Madurai's ACP gets the heat from his seniors for his team's poor performance. In order to mend that, he plans a fake operation for his team. But his plan goes awry due to a meddling sub-inspector.

title: Anbe Un Vasam
desc: A boy falls in love with a girl who also reciprocates his feelings. Scared by another love affair going sour, he proposes to her. But, things go wrong when her point of view differs from his.

title: Bharatha Rathana
desc: Nawab, a terrorist, and his men kidnap a foreign delegation that visits India. Captain Bhawani, along with her aides, has to rescue them by any means.

title: Jathi Malli
desc: After her mother's murder, singer Sriranjani moves to Ooty and meets Kesavan, another dejected soul. Along come two run-away lovers, who bring a fresh perspective to the lives of these two.

title: Puthumai Pithan
desc: Jeeva is framed and sent to a mental asylum and his family murdered when he earns the enmity of a corrupt politician. He escapes the asylum and exacts revenge on the politician who destroyed his life.

title: ABCD
desc: Anand, an MBA graduate, meets three women in different scenarios and befriends them by offering help. However, he is forced to make a wise choice as all the three women fall in love with him.

title: Pandiyan
desc: Pandiyan, a police officer, is enraged when his sister's husband dies. In order to find and catch the culprits, he goes undercover

title: Chinna Chinna Kannile
desc: When Raju loses his soft-spoken, loving elder brother Balu in a fight, he gives up his violent ways. However, his life changes for the better when he meets his brother's lookalike, who is a criminal.

title: Cheran Chozhan Pandian
desc: After being released from jail Cheran, Chozhan, and Pandian are determined to reform, they encounter the corrupt politician Swamy. They befriend Gayathri, Swamy's sister, leading to complications.

title: Amma Appa Cheliam
desc: Chellam, a boy from a poor family, is in love with a rich girl but ignores her by focusing on his career while making his parents proud by scoring the highest in the district.

title: Acharam
desc: Suriya, a sub-inspector, hates modern women and kills them secretly at night. When he meets Ramya, the wife of an architect, he becomes obsessed with her.

title: Vaanatha Pola
desc: Vellaichaamy sacrifices love for his three brothers, resisting marriage when he discovers his beloved intends to separate them.
